resources.string: Subtitles for whatever is playing on this TV, worked out on the TV itself. Nothing you watch leaves the device.
Opens Accessibility settings. Choose Live captions and turn it on.
This TV has no Accessibility settings screen. Turn the overlay on with adb, as the README explains.
Let the app hear the TV
Android calls this recording audio. The app only hears what the TV plays, never the room.
Android will ask to share your screen. Only the sound is used.
Finish the two steps above first.
Captions appear at the bottom of the screen, over any app.
Speaks a sentence so you can see captions appear.
This TV has no text-to-speech voice. Play any video with speech to check instead.
Captions are working. This sentence was spoken by the TV and written down by the app.
कैप्शन काम कर रहे हैं। यह वाक्य टीवी ने बोला और ऐप ने लिखा।
This TV has no %1$s voice. Play any video in %1$s to check instead.
Hearing nothing. If a show is playing, that app does not share its sound. Most paid streaming apps do not.
Screen sharing was declined, so captions did not start.
This TV has no screen-sharing prompt, so it cannot share its sound with the app.
Shows live captions at the bottom of the screen, over any app. It reads no screen content and sees nothing you type.
Listening to what the TV plays.
